name: ProposeAllocation
description: Allocation proposal of plan 04.11 part B (stage 6), a separate step that never blocks the receipt. For one approved receipt returns the customer's open invoices grouped by due month — source of truth: OpenMovements rows of docType חשבונית (amount > 0, docNumber = invoice number; Invoices only adds invoiceDate / original amount); open balance of an invoice = its OpenMovements amount minus every ReceiptAllocations row on it across all OTHER receipts (the receipt's own rows are the ones an approval replaces) — and the automatic proposal: oldest to newest until the amount is used, starting with the months the debt check closed (debtCheckMonths) when it closed to zero; the last invoice is partial; any surplus stays as credit on account. allocationConfidence 0–100: 100 = the debt check closed to zero and the proposal uses the amount exactly on whole invoices of those months; 80 = zero close but those months' invoices don't add up exactly; 50 = no zero close, ends exactly on whole invoices; 30 = no zero close, partial or surplus; 0 = no open invoice. dryRun = read only (the allocation editor calls it this way). Otherwise writes allocationConfidence; for a zero-closed receipt with a proposal also matchStatus 'פיזור מוצע – לאישור' and the task 'קבלה – צריך פיזור' (taskKey allocate:<receiptKey>); a 'לברר מול הלקוח' receipt gets no proposed state (its debt-check:<receiptKey> task carries it). When allocationAutoApproveAt (AgentSettings) has a value and confidence ≥ it, the proposal is applied at once through ApplyAllocation's logic with approvedBy 'אושר אוטומטית'; empty = OFF. A receipt that already has allocations is never overwritten (alreadyAllocated, current[]). IssueReceipt runs the same function right after the debt check. Never writes to Priority.

closedMonths.description: Due months the debt check closed (YYYY-MM); the proposal starts there

months.description: { dueMonth (YYYY-MM, '' = no due date), monthLabel, closedByDebtCheck, openTotal, invoices[{ invoiceNumber, invoiceDate, dueDate, invoiceAmount, openInPriority, allocatedByOthers, otherReceipts[{receiptKey, amount}], openBefore (the max that can be allocated), proposed (0 when not proposed), isPartial, current (this receipt's current allocation, 0 if none) }] }, oldest first

proposal.description: [{ invoiceNumber, amount, isPartial }] in allocation order – ready to send to ApplyAllocation

surplus.description: Credit on account beyond the open invoices

openTotal.description: Sum of the customer's open balances

current.description: The receipt's current allocation [{ invoiceNumber, amount }]

usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Opening the allocation editor**: Clicking "פיזור לחשבוניות" (or "עריכת הפיזור") on an approved receipt on the "תקבולים" screen — in the identification list, in the field agents' cheques section, or in step 4 "פיזור" of the receipt record (also opened from a receipts task)
  Loads the customer's open invoices grouped by due month, highlights the months the debt check closed, and pre-fills the suggested amount for each invoice (or the receipt's current allocation). It only reads; nothing is saved.
